<blockquote>
<p>发布日期：2026-08-31<br>
标签：前端 / React / Canvas / WebGL / 组件库 / cos-design / 视觉特效 / 交互设计</p>
</blockquote>
<p>做活动页、登录屏、品牌 Landing 时，背景常常是个尴尬的存在：纯 CSS 渐变太「模板站」，Three.js 流体 Demo 又太重，临时抄一段 CodePen 往往只能撑一次活动。</p>
<p>我在 <a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fjiaxiantao%2Fcos-design" target="_blank" title="https://github.com/jiaxiantao/cos-design" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">cos-design</a> 里一直在补这一层——<strong>可装包、可调参、能交互的背景动效</strong>。v3.6 做了深海气泡场，v3.5 做了水面涟漪和烟雾雾气，v3.7 把图片预览做成了 13 种「能摸」的交互。</p>
<p><strong>v3.8.0</strong> 这次一口气上了 5 个重磅背景组件，组件总数来到 <strong>91</strong>。它们气质完全不同，但共享同一套工程约定：<code>fill</code> 铺满、<code>bindVisibilityPause</code> 切 tab 暂停、<code>prefers-reduced-motion</code> 静态帧降级、独立 <code>@cos-design/*</code> 分包。</p>
<p>全文约 <strong>12 分钟</strong>。建议先打开 <a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fjiaxiantao.xyz%2Fcos-design%2F%23%2F" target="_blank" title="https://jiaxiantao.xyz/cos-design/#/" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">Playground</a>（侧栏 → 背景动效），边读边摸——每个组件我都按<strong>侧栏顺序</strong>写：先讲为什么要做，再拆核心实现，最后留关键交互帧给你对照。</p>
<p><strong>仓库</strong>：<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fjiaxiantao%2Fcos-design" target="_blank" title="https://github.com/jiaxiantao/cos-design" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">github.com/jiaxiantao/…</a> · <strong>版本</strong>：<code>cos-design@3.8.0</code></p>









































<table><thead><tr><th>组件</th><th>中文</th><th>渲染路线</th><th>独立包</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><code>SoapBubbles</code></td><td>肥皂泡天空</td><td>Canvas 2D 薄膜光学 + 融合</td><td><code>@cos-design/soap-bubbles</code></td></tr><tr><td><code>DandelionField</code></td><td>蒲公英播种</td><td>Canvas 2D 生命周期 + 物理</td><td><code>@cos-design/dandelion-field</code></td></tr><tr><td><code>LavaBubble</code></td><td>熔岩泡</td><td>CPU 场仿真 + WebGL 着色</td><td><code>@cos-design/lava-bubble</code></td></tr><tr><td><code>InkBloom</code></td><td>墨染清水</td><td>Canvas 2D 密度/速度场</td><td><code>@cos-design/ink-bloom</code></td></tr><tr><td><code>AuroraVeil</code></td><td>极光帷幕</td><td>Canvas 2D 光带轮廓</td><td><code>@cos-design/aurora-veil</code></td></tr></tbody></table>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-0">开场：五个场景，五种「介质」</h2>
<p>下面五张图，就是 Playground 里五个新组件的默认态——从肥皂泡到极光，一张比一张「不像 CSS 能做出来的」：</p>
<p><img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/27430329d3de4c9399f2c34025120ef0~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg54mn6Im6:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1794376745&amp;x-signature=Y7ozgN6Mkz1j8N5H6lx49%2BowKB8%3D" alt="SoapBubbles 肥皂泡天空 — 虹彩薄膜缓缓上升" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/62bb24936d75486994ac53d4da0e1011~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg54mn6Im6:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1794376745&amp;x-signature=HCUoknE0ri8Y8mnJUvngTnAC5kg%3D" alt="DandelionField 蒲公英播种 — 多株绒球静立草坡" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/c2aa4d9eb2c94786a61e00d84cab2655~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg54mn6Im6:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1794376745&amp;x-signature=tUdKSWjMY0vOuPoVB560gKa7Y9o%3D" alt="LavaBubble 熔岩泡 — 暗红湖面随机闷胀" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/24f3c6f5a86c4d27b56aee4310bf8092~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg54mn6Im6:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1794376745&amp;x-signature=mKw81gjToqfoGGKlxdWYYHkM6fA%3D" alt="InkBloom 墨染清水 — 一盆尚浅的清水" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/1448543998c14ac7b1b5f067d23e4249~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg54mn6Im6:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1794376745&amp;x-signature=2pFRqBJ49oRcZmAUbDufIKGWn6c%3D" alt="AuroraVeil 极光帷幕 — 星夜垂落光带" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>这五个组件不是「五种配色方案」，而是五种<strong>介质模型</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>肥皂泡</strong> — 薄膜干涉色 + 上升气流 + 融合/爆裂</li>
<li><strong>蒲公英</strong> — 植株生命周期 + 种子飘飞 + 落地发芽闭环</li>
<li><strong>熔岩</strong> — 壳层鼓起、闷裂、空腔回填的高度场</li>
<li><strong>墨染</strong> — 浓墨滴入清水后的密度场流体</li>
<li><strong>极光</strong> — 垂向光带在星夜里的弯曲与脉冲</li>
</ul>
<p>对外都是几个 props；对内各自拆模块。接下来五个章节，我会按这个顺序往下走——<strong>每节末尾留 Playground 链接，方便你对照动效</strong>。</p>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-1">一、SoapBubbles：薄膜光学，不是几个半透明圆</h2>
<p>v3.8.0 的第一个背景，我从最「轻」的开始：纯 Canvas 2D，没有场仿真，但要骗过眼睛——泡膜得泛虹彩，碰在一起得会融，戳破得溅水珠。</p>
<p><img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/88bf209fcc934c4e9755d97c9dd44922~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg54mn6Im6:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1794376745&amp;x-signature=VvTmdkVllYUJe4afD%2FEEJStChTs%3D" alt="SoapBubbles 默认飘飞 — 不同深度的泡各有虹彩" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 data-id="heading-2">它解决什么问题？</h3>
<p>「肥皂泡背景」最容易翻车：画几个 <code>arc</code> + 白高光，看起来像玻璃球。真实肥皂泡的关键是<strong>薄膜干涉</strong>——厚度变化带来彩虹色斑，以及<strong>融合时 neck 收缩</strong>的 metaball 形态。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-3">核心实现：film + merge + pop 三件套</h3>
<p><strong>薄膜色</strong> <code>film.ts</code>：<code>filmRgb(thickness)</code> 在 8 个干涉色 stop 间插值；<code>drawSoapIridescence</code> 在泡内撒 7~12 个 <code>softBlob</code> 色斑 + rim 色带，按 <code>lambertAtAngle</code> 受光。</p>
<p><strong>运动</strong>：每个泡有 <code>rise</code>（上升力）、<code>gust</code>（阵风倍率）、<code>drift</code>（横向目标），用指数 ease 追踪目标速度——不是匀速上升，而是「忽快忽慢、左右晃」。</p>
<p><strong>融合</strong> <code>merge.ts</code>：近距先弱吸引，触及时 30% 概率双爆、70% 进入 merge 状态机。<code>resolveMergePose</code> 分 <strong>approach / absorb</strong> 两阶段，体积按 <code>∛(r₁³+r₂³)</code> 守恒，绘制时用 metaball 轮廓（与 <a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fjiaxiantao.xyz%2Fcos-design%2F%23%2FbubbleField" target="_blank" title="https://jiaxiantao.xyz/cos-design/#/bubbleField" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">BubbleField</a> 同思路）。</p>
<p><strong>爆裂</strong> <code>popBubble</code>：14+ 颗 bead 水珠沿点击反方向飞出 + 28+ 颗 mist 微粒；pop 动画结束后 <code>spawnBubble</code> 从底部补新泡。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-tsx" lang="tsx"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { <span class="hljs-title class_">SoapBubbles</span> } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@cos-design/soap-bubbles'</span>;

<span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">SoapBubbles</span> <span class="hljs-attr">fill</span> <span class="hljs-attr">count</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{28}</span> <span class="hljs-attr">speed</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{1}</span> /&gt;</span></span>
</code></pre>
<p>左：点击戳破，膜 fade 的同时水珠飞出。右：两泡靠近融合，颈部收缩成 metaball 连体。</p>
<img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/da3d01a102b24bc0881dd96d481c6641~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg54mn6Im6:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1794376745&amp;x-signature=DfDhgH9gr3NDojPzaCektLc3Z0I%3D" alt="SoapBubbles 点击爆裂" width="45%" loading="lazy">
<img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/70522fd0509c466482bf20e2c09a263c~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg54mn6Im6:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1794376745&amp;x-signature=JfQL9LibgTLWx%2BroUVXJDOQXDic%3D" alt="SoapBubbles 双泡融合" width="45%" loading="lazy">
<p><strong>一句话带走</strong>：虹彩来自薄膜厚度插值，灵魂在 merge 状态机——体积守恒 + metaball 绘制。</p>
<p>👉 试玩：<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fjiaxiantao.xyz%2Fcos-design%2F%23%2FsoapBubbles" target="_blank" title="https://jiaxiantao.xyz/cos-design/#/soapBubbles" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">#/soapBubbles</a></p>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-4">二、DandelionField：一整片会呼吸的生命循环</h2>
<p>肥皂泡是「死物物理」；第二个组件我想做<strong>活物逻辑</strong>——不是粒子往上飘，而是一株株蒲公英真的在长高、开花、变绒球、被风吹散、再发芽。Playground 里等 intro 动画播完，你会看到草坡上一片 mature 绒球，那就是最佳阅读起点。</p>
<p><img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/ac528964215b42e9a447752c9f90bc4f~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg54mn6Im6:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1794376745&amp;x-signature=%2Bng8zb6obbSxw5XPS%2B%2BDI1Rnb5o%3D" alt="DandelionField 成熟态 — 多株绒球静立草坡" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 data-id="heading-5">它解决什么问题？</h3>
<p>「飘絮粒子」Demo 很多，但很少做成<strong>完整生态</strong>：发芽 → 开花 → 变绒球 → 被风吹散 → 种子落地 → 再发芽。DandelionField 要的是这个闭环，而且鼠标滑过要像真的在吹风。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-6">核心实现：模块化生命周期</h3>
<p>源码按职责拆成六个文件——v3.8.0 CHANGELOG 里专门提到的重构：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-bash" lang="bash">dandelionField/
├── index.tsx      <span class="hljs-comment"># React 外壳、主循环、指针风场</span>
├── plant.ts       <span class="hljs-comment"># 植株状态机：sprout → flower → puffing → mature → wither</span>
├── seed.ts        <span class="hljs-comment"># 附着/脱离、飘飞、落地、发芽</span>
├── draw.ts        <span class="hljs-comment"># 茎叶、绒球、种子、光晕</span>
├── scene.ts       <span class="hljs-comment"># 静态背景 + 草簇风摆</span>
└── frame-cache.ts <span class="hljs-comment"># 植株几何缓存（每帧不算两次 head 位置）</span>
</code></pre>
<p><strong>植株状态机</strong>是灵魂。以 <code>mature</code> 为例：先 <code>matureHoldLeft</code> 随机驻留，到期后 <code>beginReleasing</code>，按 <code>scheduledRelease</code> 时间轴<strong>不规则</strong>释放种子——外圈先飞、内圈后飞，而不是一次性爆炸。</p>
<p><strong>指针风场</strong>：<code>pointermove</code> 根据位移速度算 gust，扫过 mature/puffing 绒球且距离 &lt; 105×scale 时，<code>boostPlantRelease</code> 加速散种；点击最近绒球则 <code>boostPlantRelease(2.8)</code> 整朵炸开。</p>
<p><strong>种子发芽</strong>：落地后延迟 <code>germinateDelay</code>，按 <code>GERMINATION_CHANCE</code> / <code>GERMINATION_NEAR_CHANCE</code> 决定是否在附近长出新株——离母株越近概率越高，视觉上像「一片草地慢慢蔓延」。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-tsx" lang="tsx"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { <span class="hljs-title class_">DandelionField</span> } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@cos-design/dandelion-field'</span>;

<span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">DandelionField</span> <span class="hljs-attr">fill</span> <span class="hljs-attr">plantCount</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{10}</span> <span class="hljs-attr">seedCount</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{32}</span> <span class="hljs-attr">speed</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{1}</span> /&gt;</span></span>
</code></pre>
<p>左：快速划过绒球，风场加速散种。右：点击整朵炸开，种子刚离体的一瞬。</p>
<img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/b5e2390bd81348eea5257b1867b6729b~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg54mn6Im6:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1794376745&amp;x-signature=cfZsOSAxXC%2B6FBgsXe5oJBoHags%3D" alt="DandelionField 滑动吹风散种" width="30%" loading="lazy">
<img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/ddfdacb9117746cc8e2e81a77094980a~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg54mn6Im6:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1794376745&amp;x-signature=XxMhCGrxnozvGT2o6UY%2Fw2F9OUQ%3D" alt="DandelionField 点击炸开绒球" width="50%" loading="lazy">
<p><strong>性能优化</strong>（v3.8.0 重点）：<code>PlantFrameCache</code> 缓存 head/life 几何；<code>AttachedSeedTracker</code> 用计数器替代每帧 <code>filter</code> 附着种子——植株多时帧率更稳。</p>
<p><strong>一句话带走</strong>：这不是粒子系统，是带 germination 闭环的植株状态机 + 指针风场。</p>
<p>👉 试玩：<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fjiaxiantao.xyz%2Fcos-design%2F%23%2FdandelionField" target="_blank" title="https://jiaxiantao.xyz/cos-design/#/dandelionField" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">#/dandelionField</a>（建议先等 intro 播完再摸）</p>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-7">三、LavaBubble：CPU 算场，GPU 只看</h2>
<p>前两个都是 Canvas 2D。第三个我想做「硬介质」——熔岩湖。难点不在颜色渐变，而在<strong>完整事件链</strong>：鼓起 → 变薄 → 闷裂 → 空腔 → 回填，还要能点击、能拖拽撕裂。这是五个组件里唯一上了 WebGL 的。</p>
<p><img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/40d081107e534f0ebde734963d99c083~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg54mn6Im6:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1794376745&amp;x-signature=sDrvTbL1MQX86nRyg68wUQNBlsY%3D" alt="LavaBubble 自动鼓泡 — 湖面随机闷胀" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 data-id="heading-8">它解决什么问题？</h3>
<p>熔岩/岩浆视觉在 Web 里常被做成 looping 视频或纯 shader 噪声——能看，但很难<strong>点击鼓起 → 壳裂 → 溅射 → 空腔回填</strong>这一完整事件链。LavaBubble 拆成：<strong>CPU 192×192 场仿真</strong>写纹理，<strong>WebGL 片段着色</strong>读高度/热量/空腔做法线光照。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-9">核心实现：Blister 四阶段状态机</h3>
<p>每个 blister 经历：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-scss" lang="scss">inflate（壳层隆起）→ thin（变薄、裂纹发热）→ burst（撕裂空腔 + 溅射）→ cavity（回填、余温）
</code></pre>
<p><code>sim.ts</code> 里维护三张标量场：</p>
<ul>
<li><code>heightField</code>：隆起高度</li>
<li><code>heatF</code>：热量（写回 shader 做辉度）</li>
<li><code>cavityF</code>：爆裂后的空腔深度</li>
</ul>
<p><code>upload()</code> 把 RGBA 纹理打包：<code>R=height, G=heat, B=cavity</code>。</p>
<p>片段着色器 <code>shaders.ts</code> 从纹理采样后：</p>
<ol>
<li><code>calcNormal</code> 算法线（空腔会「挖深」法线）</li>
<li><code>heatColor(t)</code> 六段渐变——<strong>最低也是暗红</strong>，避免纯黑熔壳</li>
<li>wrap lighting + 双层 specular + 空腔 rim 余温</li>
</ol>
<p>交互两路：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>点击</strong> <code>spawnBlister(u,v)</code> 在 UV 坐标鼓新泡</li>
<li><strong>拖拽</strong> <code>applyStir</code> 注入涡旋、螺旋热纹、椭圆 shell crack，并 <code>stirBlister</code> 加速未爆泡的裂纹</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="hljs language-tsx" lang="tsx"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { <span class="hljs-title class_">LavaBubble</span> } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@cos-design/lava-bubble'</span>;

<span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">LavaBubble</span> <span class="hljs-attr">fill</span> <span class="hljs-attr">heat</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{1}</span> <span class="hljs-attr">autoSpawn</span> <span class="hljs-attr">activity</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{1}</span> <span class="hljs-attr">speed</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{1}</span> /&gt;</span></span>
</code></pre>
<p>左：点击后 burst 相，空腔 + 溅射热纹。右：壳层隆起、裂纹发热的 thin 阶段。</p>
<img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/13097278587e444fb4a83fcfefb495ad~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg54mn6Im6:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1794376745&amp;x-signature=yhDJYybedTyb6DSQKwLibxFQoNk%3D" alt="LavaBubble 点击爆裂" width="50%" loading="lazy">
<img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/24d27d7e3f134b0a913504eebce8c569~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg54mn6Im6:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1794376745&amp;x-signature=hRuC2NKzoylGNdoLGToAT2qQdJg%3D" alt="LavaBubble 壳层隆起" width="40%" loading="lazy">
<p><strong>为什么 CPU + GPU 分工？</strong> 气泡生命周期、溅射粒子（mist/bomb/crust 三类 spatter）、热扩散需要随机性和分支逻辑，放 CPU 更直观；全屏像素着色交给 GPU，192² 纹理足够表达「湖面的起伏与裂口」。</p>
<p><strong>一句话带走</strong>：仿真在 CPU，观感在 GPU——纹理 RGB 三包 height / heat / cavity。</p>
<p>👉 试玩：<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fjiaxiantao.xyz%2Fcos-design%2F%23%2FlavaBubble" target="_blank" title="https://jiaxiantao.xyz/cos-design/#/lavaBubble" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">#/lavaBubble</a>（<code>autoSpawn</code> 开着等几秒，看随机鼓泡）</p>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-10">四、InkBloom：一滴墨，两种场</h2>
<p>熔岩是「硬壳 + 碎裂」；第四个我想做完全相反的质感——<strong>软、慢、会累积</strong>。墨水滴进清水，溶开后整盆水越来越深——这种「越摸越深」的反馈，blur 圆叠不出来。</p>
<p><img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/26bc0078ea434495b70c52035429fef1~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg54mn6Im6:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1794376745&amp;x-signature=ilqfVF3rgo%2BnoTYVcoTfJQYryCk%3D" alt="InkBloom 刚滴墨 — 浓墨心 + 羽状外晕" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 data-id="heading-11">它解决什么问题？</h3>
<p>「墨水扩散」特效常见做法是叠几张 blur 圆——像，但缺少<strong>溶开</strong>和<strong>整片水被染深</strong>的累积感。InkBloom 用轻量 2D 流体近似：<strong>密度场 + 速度场 + 持久染色场</strong>。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-12">核心实现：三缓冲区 + 低分辨率仿真</h3>
<p>仿真网格 <code>simW × simH ≈ 画布 / 4</code>，每格维护：</p>

























<table><thead><tr><th>场</th><th>变量</th><th>作用</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>密度</td><td><code>dens</code></td><td>当前悬浮的浓/淡墨团</td></tr><tr><td>速度</td><td><code>vx</code>, <code>vy</code></td><td>平流 + 涡旋驱动</td></tr><tr><td>染色</td><td><code>stain</code></td><td>已溶入水中、几乎不退色的背景色</td></tr></tbody></table>
<p>主循环（每帧）：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-scss" lang="scss">applyForces → 粘滞衰减 → <span class="hljs-built_in">advect</span>(dens) → diffuseDensity
→ <span class="hljs-built_in">advect</span>(velocity) → dens 溶入 stain → stain 缓慢铺匀
→ <span class="hljs-built_in">paintWater</span>(avgStain) → renderStain → renderInk
</code></pre>
<p><strong>点击注入</strong> <code>injectDrop</code> 做三件事：不规则浓墨心（fbm 扰动边界）、3~6 个随机涡旋（切向速度）、外圈 22 点淡墨晕。<strong>拖拽</strong> <code>injectStir</code> 把指针位移写进速度场。</p>
<p>力场里值得单独说的一句是<strong>涡度约束</strong>——从 <code>curl</code> 场反推侧向推力，拉出絮状细丝，避免每次扩散都是完美圆：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> cx = (curl[i + <span class="hljs-number">1</span>] - curl[i - <span class="hljs-number">1</span>]) * <span class="hljs-number">0.5</span>;
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> cy = (curl[i + simW] - curl[i - simW]) * <span class="hljs-number">0.5</span>;
vx[i] += (cy / len) * curl[i] * eps;
vy[i] -= (cx / len) * curl[i] * eps;
</code></pre>
<p><strong>质量守恒的染色</strong>：浓团 <code>dissolve</code> 后质量转入 <code>stain</code>，<code>paintWater</code> 根据 <code>avgStain</code> 把清水从 <code>#c5dff0</code> 渐变为 <code>#12151a</code>——点得越多，整盆水越深，这是和「一次性 blur 圆」最大的体验差异。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-tsx" lang="tsx"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { <span class="hljs-title class_">InkBloom</span> } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@cos-design/ink-bloom'</span>;

<span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">InkBloom</span> <span class="hljs-attr">fill</span> <span class="hljs-attr">inkColor</span>=<span class="hljs-string">"#0c0e12"</span> <span class="hljs-attr">speed</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{1}</span> /&gt;</span></span>
</code></pre>
<p>上：单点滴墨，羽状晕开。下：连续多点后，整片清水被染深——注意背景色已从浅蓝变成深灰。</p>
<p><img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/0f67fce0c76e43deb205d5123f8f3681~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg54mn6Im6:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1794376745&amp;x-signature=xqBr1%2F8rQRU8ibxUv0hbQUyLF0k%3D" alt="InkBloom 单点扩散 — 絮状细丝" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/b60a44b4ee824eec8f66e8a8be31a59d~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg54mn6Im6:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1794376745&amp;x-signature=0KA5CC6bV1Om70TzNcaWNwZtKxs%3D" alt="InkBloom 多点染深 — 整盆水变深" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>一句话带走</strong>：<code>dens</code> 是悬浮墨团，<code>stain</code> 是已溶入水的永久染色——质量守恒，越点越深。</p>
<p>👉 试玩：<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fjiaxiantao.xyz%2Fcos-design%2F%23%2FinkBloom" target="_blank" title="https://jiaxiantao.xyz/cos-design/#/inkBloom" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">#/inkBloom</a>（连续点 5~8 次，等十秒看背景变深）</p>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-13">五、AuroraVeil：把极光画成「可弯曲的丝带」</h2>
<p>五个里最后做、也最「登页面」的一个。极光背景烂大街，但多数要么像壁纸、要么 shader 调参劝退。我想用纯 Canvas 2D 做出<strong>光带能被鼠标弯曲、点击能爆发脉冲</strong>的北极夜——不引 WebGL，但要够「哇」。</p>
<p><img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/24ac527592fb4e25a65bc1a3d605e44c~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg54mn6Im6:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1794376745&amp;x-signature=IFFe5eORjOHEz8O3n0nrcULtT9k%3D" alt="AuroraVeil 默认态 — 星夜 + 多层垂落光带" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 data-id="heading-14">它解决什么问题？</h3>
<p>市面上「极光背景」常见两条路：CSS 渐变动画（轻，但像壁纸）或 WebGL 噪声场（真，但调参成本高）。AuroraVeil 选中间态：<strong>纯 Canvas 2D</strong>，用<strong>逐行轮廓</strong>描述光带，再用离屏 buffer + <code>screen</code> 混合叠出辉光。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-15">核心实现：EdgeProfile 光带</h3>
<p>每条光带（Veil）不是一张图片，而是一列 <strong>y → 中心 x、半宽 hw</strong> 的采样：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-ts" lang="ts"><span class="hljs-comment">// 每一行 y：正弦波叠加 drift + 指针磁吸 + 点击脉冲扰动</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">centerX</span> = (<span class="hljs-params">veil, y, time, sheet</span>) =&gt; { <span class="hljs-comment">/* wave + drift + pointer magnet */</span> };
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">halfWidth</span> = (<span class="hljs-params">veil, y, time, sheet</span>) =&gt; { <span class="hljs-comment">/* 指针附近收窄 */</span> };

<span class="hljs-comment">// Float32Array 缓存左右边缘，拼成闭合 ribbon</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> buildProfile = (veil, time, sheet): <span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">EdgeProfile</span> =&gt;</span> { <span class="hljs-comment">/* leftBuf / rightBuf */</span> };
</code></pre>
<p>渲染分三层：</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>paintSky</strong>：深空渐变 + 260 颗按深度闪烁的星 + 地平线暗角</li>
<li><strong>fillRibbon</strong>：水平/垂直双色渐变，<code>source-atop</code> 做垂向衰减</li>
<li><strong>离屏合成</strong>：主 sheet <code>screen</code> 叠一层，再 blur 2.4px 的 glowSheet 做柔辉</li>
</ol>
<p>交互上，指针会<strong>磁吸弯曲</strong>最近光带、<strong>收窄</strong>经过区域的半宽；点击触发 <code>burstRef</code> 整屏 ripple + 最多 4 个扩散 pulse。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-tsx" lang="tsx"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { <span class="hljs-title class_">AuroraVeil</span> } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@cos-design/aurora-veil'</span>;

<span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">AuroraVeil</span> <span class="hljs-attr">fill</span> <span class="hljs-attr">colors</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{[</span>'#<span class="hljs-attr">7ee8d8</span>', '#<span class="hljs-attr">4cc9f0</span>', '#<span class="hljs-attr">9d8df1</span>']} <span class="hljs-attr">bandCount</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{5}</span> <span class="hljs-attr">speed</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{1}</span> /&gt;</span></span>
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://p3-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/4f164b166345449a8131b6b8f2005632~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg54mn6Im6:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1794376745&amp;x-signature=p9G5EsVwMD5lG42L%2Bjf0TCqrIbM%3D" alt="AuroraVeil 点击脉冲 — 光带爆发能量波纹" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>工程细节</strong>：<code>MAX_DPR = 2</code>；<code>prefers-reduced-motion</code> 时 stars 停止 twinkle、光带冻结；与 BubbleField 一样走 <code>@cos-design/shared</code> 的 <code>useCanvasBox</code>。</p>
<p><strong>一句话带走</strong>：光带不是贴图，是逐行 EdgeProfile + 离屏 glow 合成。</p>
<p>👉 试玩：<a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fjiaxiantao.xyz%2Fcos-design%2F%23%2FauroraVeil" target="_blank" title="https://jiaxiantao.xyz/cos-design/#/auroraVeil" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">#/auroraVeil</a>（在光带中心点一下，看脉冲扩散）</p>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-16">六、五个组件怎么选？一张表说清楚</h2>
<p>五个组件读下来，你可能已经在脑子里对上了场景。我把选型收成一张表——<strong>按 Playground 侧栏顺序排列</strong>，方便回去对照：</p>









































<table><thead><tr><th>你要的气质</th><th>推荐组件</th><th>交互方式</th><th>渲染成本</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>童趣 / 夏日 / 轻活动</td><td>SoapBubbles</td><td>点击戳破、自动融合</td><td>中（纯 Canvas）</td></tr><tr><td>治愈 / 春季活动 / 自然系</td><td>DandelionField</td><td>滑动吹风、点击炸开</td><td>中高（多实体 + 生命周期）</td></tr><tr><td>硬核 / 游戏 / 暗黑 Hero</td><td>LavaBubble</td><td>点击鼓泡、拖拽撕裂</td><td>中高（WebGL + CPU sim）</td></tr><tr><td>国风 / 文艺 / 留白排版</td><td>InkBloom</td><td>点击滴墨、拖拽搅动</td><td>中（低分辨率场）</td></tr><tr><td>科技感 / 登录屏 / 北欧夜</td><td>AuroraVeil</td><td>移动弯曲、点击脉冲</td><td>中（离屏 blur）</td></tr></tbody></table>
<p>还有一个 cos-design 一贯建议：<strong>一页只放一个强全屏动效背景</strong>。第二个背景请降尺寸或关 <code>interactive</code>，否则抢视觉、也抢 GPU。</p>
<p>如果五个都想试一遍，Playground 侧栏从上往下点就行——和本文顺序完全一致。</p>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-17">七、工程化：分包、降级、Next.js</h2>
<p>五个组件均已独立发布，可按需安装——不必为了一个肥皂泡拖进整个库：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-bash" lang="bash">pnpm add @cos-design/soap-bubbles @cos-design/dandelion-field @cos-design/lava-bubble @cos-design/ink-bloom @cos-design/aurora-veil
<span class="hljs-comment"># 或全量</span>
pnpm add cos-design@3.8.0
</code></pre>
<p>Next.js App Router 记得动态导入 + <code>ssr: false</code>（Canvas/WebGL 仅客户端）：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-tsx" lang="tsx"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> dynamic <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'next/dynamic'</span>;

<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">SoapBubbles</span> = <span class="hljs-title function_">dynamic</span>(
  <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">import</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'@cos-design/soap-bubbles'</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">then</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">m</span>) =&gt;</span> m.<span class="hljs-property">SoapBubbles</span>),
  { <span class="hljs-attr">ssr</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">false</span> }
);

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">default</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">Hero</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> (
    <span class="xml"><span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">section</span> <span class="hljs-attr">style</span>=<span class="hljs-string">{{</span> <span class="hljs-attr">position:</span> '<span class="hljs-attr">relative</span>', <span class="hljs-attr">minHeight:</span> '<span class="hljs-attr">100vh</span>' }}&gt;</span>
      <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;<span class="hljs-name">SoapBubbles</span> <span class="hljs-attr">fill</span> /&gt;</span>
      {/* 前景内容 z-index 需高于 canvas */}
    <span class="hljs-tag">&lt;/<span class="hljs-name">section</span>&gt;</span></span>
  );
}
</code></pre>
<p>共享约定（v3.7 起逐步统一，五个新组件全部遵循）：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong><code>fill</code></strong>：父级需有明确高度（如 <code>100vh</code>），组件铺满</li>
<li><strong><code>bindVisibilityPause</code></strong>：切 tab 停 rAF，省电</li>
<li><strong><code>prefers-reduced-motion</code></strong>：静态帧，不黑屏</li>
<li><strong>Playwright smoke</strong>：v3.8.0 为新组件补了 canvas 挂载测试</li>
</ul>
<p><code>@cos-design/shared</code> 本版还导出了 <code>softSat</code> 等数学工具，供后续组件复用。</p>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-18">收尾：从 Demo 到「介质库」</h2>
<p>回头看 v3.8.0，这五个组件不是简单「+5」，而是在补 cos-design 背景线的<strong>介质维度</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>SoapBubbles → <strong>薄膜</strong></li>
<li>DandelionField → <strong>生命</strong></li>
<li>LavaBubble → <strong>热/壳层</strong></li>
<li>InkBloom → <strong>流体</strong></li>
<li>AuroraVeil → <strong>光</strong></li>
</ul>
<p>它们和早期的 WeatherBackground、BubbleField、RippleWater 一起，构成一套「不用 Three.js 也能做重磅背景」的选项库。</p>
<p>如果你只来得及摸一个：夏日活动页戳 <a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fjiaxiantao.xyz%2Fcos-design%2F%23%2FsoapBubbles" target="_blank" title="https://jiaxiantao.xyz/cos-design/#/soapBubbles" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">SoapBubbles</a>，登录屏弯曲 <a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fjiaxiantao.xyz%2Fcos-design%2F%23%2FauroraVeil" target="_blank" title="https://jiaxiantao.xyz/cos-design/#/auroraVeil" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">AuroraVeil</a>，国风留白滴 <a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fjiaxiantao.xyz%2Fcos-design%2F%23%2FinkBloom" target="_blank" title="https://jiaxiantao.xyz/cos-design/#/inkBloom" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">InkBloom</a>。<strong>背景能不能留人，往往差的就是这一层可交互的介质感</strong>——读完这篇，打开 Playground 走一遍侧栏，比看十张截图都直观。</p>
<hr>
